title: VS10048AMN owner verifies the six readings on the installed Q1 map
summary: After updating to 3c652a66, restarting HA and selecting the 24-cell map, the owner reported that the five existing readings remained and Battery Voltage tracked the inverter LCD during normal PV charging (56.16 V in HA, 56.2 V on the LCD). This confirms the read-only map on the reported configuration, not automatic recognition of other Q1 devices or write support.
